desktopSettings.customTokenPlaceholder: Leave blank to generate a secure token
desktopSettings.customTokenDesc: Use 16-256 characters, or leave this blank and Kith-space will generate a high-entropy token.

desktopSettings.tokenRotated: Access Token rotated. Existing browser sessions are no longer authorized.
desktopSettings.oneTimeTokenDesc: For security, this value is shown only once. It cannot be recovered later; you can only rotate it.
desktopSettings.sessionsDesc: Remove access from every browser without changing the Access Token.

members.rosterEmptyCreate: Click the + next to Agents on the left to create one.

members.workspaceHint: Click a file on the left to view its contents

members.startFailed: Couldn't start the agent. Check the Local Runtime and try again.
members.agentCreatedOffline: Agent created, but the Local Runtime is unavailable so it hasn't started yet. It can be started after the runtime is ready.
members.restartDesc: Stop and restart the agent process, keeping the current session and workspace files.
members.resetDesc: Clear the running session and restart; workspace files (MEMORY.md, notes/) are preserved.
members.fullResetDesc: Clear the session and delete all workspace files, starting fresh.
